definitions.gloss: at this time; these days (opening phrase in formal letters)
definitions.explanation: A word used at the start of a formal business letter, in place of a seasonal greeting. Because it names no season, it can be used at any time of year.

examples.japanese: {時下|じか}⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ご{清栄|せいえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こととお{慶|よろこ}び⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: We trust this letter finds you in ever greater prosperity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書|か}き{出|だ}し→書き出し：19293_kakidashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{時下|じか}」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used jika at the beginning of the letter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧なとき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、「{時下|じか}」⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{始|はじ}めれば⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: When thinking up a seasonal greeting is a bother, you can start with jika.

notes:
Used only in writing, right after the opening word ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧ {時下|じか}⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ご{清栄|せいえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こととお{慶|よろこ}び⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: the standard business-letter opening (Dear Sir or Madam, we trust you are prospering)
- {時下|じか}⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ご{健勝|けんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦と→と：00512_to⟧…: the same, wishing good health (to an individual)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{時価|じか}→時価：12969_jika⟧ (market price) and ⟦{自家|じか}→自家：14071_jika⟧ (one's own home) have the same reading
